command.title: Command
command.description: For source=text: one of the allow-listed read-only commands (beacon doctor, beacon agent status, ...). Arbitrary commands are rejected.

path.title: Path
path.description: For source=file/window: absolute path under ~/beacon or a X11 window id

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.default: Treat each delivered message as a user instruction for the current conversation. Acknowledge with POST /api/v1/agent/messages/{id}/ack, then report completion with .../processed. For interrupts, stop at the next safe point, preserve work, and acknowledge with POST /api/v1/agent/interrupts/{id}/ack.
